intent: Keep historical, current and future fronts discoverable without merging their distinct identities or treating metaphors as proven mechanisms.
core_rules: One source-bound identity may have many divergent media, cultural, human and machine projections.
Every relation includes its direction, meaning and evidence boundary; inverses permit discovery, not authority transfer.
New strands are additive qualified candidates, with dissent, lineage, intentional retirements and missing coverage preserved.
Fan-out across diverse independent challenges; fan-in by one serialized, accountable merge writer.
Public-safe material may be linked openly; private source requires consent and a separate authorized receiver.
No endlessly repeated wave without fresh hypothesis, evidence, challenge, audience or useful output.
Golden braid is a design metaphor, not proof of a mathematical universal or divine causation.

front_contract.read: Discover relevant source objects and check exact identity and permission.
front_contract.contribute: Propose a meaningful source-bound change with falsifier and receipt.
front_contract.merge: Accept only via authorized collision-checked review.
front_contract.resume: Recover last-known-good, remaining gaps and next wake.
front_contract.render: Provide accessible visual, diagrammatic, cultural or machine projection without implying equivalence where not established.

next_proof: Independently consume one strand of each of three different types and issue receipts proving both exact source and interpreted relation.
